patch.value: closeout-workflow.test.ts fails wholesale on the local shared host while CI stays green on main

Running the closeout workflow suite on the package worktree fails nearly every test on pristine main (assertions receive git branch-switch output and a pm 'Command failed' receipt instead of expected diagnostics), while the CI workflow on the same main commit is green. The suite also exceeds 4 minutes locally and hits local timeouts. Root-cause the host-local incompatibility (host git version prints advice output the fixtures do not expect) or make the fixtures version-tolerant; out of scope for the release-tag normalization work.

value.text: PR 221 review-round baseline confirmation: with Node 26.13.0/npm 11.20.0, public npm config and isolated Git config, the single schedule-without-repository-payload scenario fails on both the branch and a disposable origin/main snapshot (650797d). Exact command: nice -n 10 node --test --test-concurrency=2 --test-name-pattern="schedule without repository payload" test/closeout-workflow.test.ts . Failure is npm EUSAGE: npm ci requires a package-lock in the synthetic caller, despite the fixture npm shim. The closeout workflow and test are byte-identical between branch and main. This is an environment-specific baseline fixture failure, not attributed to the Dependabot policy changes. No fixture or threshold was weakened. Full release evidence is being collected separately in CI on c21d40e.
